changelog: LLM-authored hook scripts: when the effect table doesn't cover the request, the LLM may now author a GDScript hook (extends ModHook) for the mod — data hooks are still preferred whenever they can express it. Hook scripts may call ONLY the ModAPI allowlist; anything else is rejected with the violation named. Step/time budget (200 calls / 100 ms per run, 250 ms per dispatch) with visible disable. Approval shows the script source + LLM-authored label; the sandbox runs code hooks and reports them. Pull/vortex verified end-to-end. Honest limit: a tight loop with no API calls cannot be preempted.
